title: Twinflame creates hasty token copies and exiles them at the next end step
plain_english: P0 casts the real frozen-Oracle Twinflame with two distinct controlled creature targets and pays the declared additional target cost.
After all players pass, Twinflame resolves and creates two synthetic token-copy permanents with haste and no physical-card components.
Each token-copy creation records a delayed exile trigger for the next end step.
At the next end step the delayed triggers are put on the stack in deterministic order.
Each delayed trigger resolves through the production stack path, moves its referenced token to exile, and state-based actions then make that synthetic object cease to exist.

preconditions: two distinct P0-controlled creatures are on the battlefield
P0 can pay the base and per-target-beyond-first mana costs
ordered_operations: all players pass to resolve Twinflame
all players pass for delayed trigger one
all players pass for delayed trigger two
required_assertions: exactly two TOKEN_COPY permanents are created
exactly two delayed triggers are created
both token copies are retired and ceased_to_exist after delayed exile
